C1664.title: AWS WAF Credential Stuffing Attack Mitigation Project
C1664.summary: This project demonstrates a credential stuffing mitigation solution for a fintech API. Attackers simulate bulk credential stuffing attacks against a Flask API login endpoint using Python scripts, attempting to exhaust authentication resources.
